text: Painting is a core field of visual arts. It uses a two-dimensional plane as a carrier and expresses thoughts, emotions and aesthetic concepts through elements such as color, lines and composition. This major integrates traditional techniques with contemporary artistic concepts, covering multiple media such as oil painting, watercolor, printmaking, and mixed media, aiming to cultivate compound talents with artistic creation, theoretical research, and cross-disciplinary practical abilities. Its essence is to explore human nature, society and nature through visual language, with both artistic and critical qualities.
